- issue_comment created in `idea-repo`#7 ("Protocol detail: floor and the k_max subset on the common target set; minimum cells in T") by `idea-repo`  > Chosen in Brief rev. 5 (wiki ac40f7c), 'Floor and eligibility': floor = all of the model's observed cells in C; a (model, split) pair is eligible at k if the model has >= k observed cells in C and >= m_T = max(3, ceil(|T|/3)) observed cells in T (ineligible pairs dropped, not imputed; a model enters a k only if eligible in >= 20 splits or 50% of splits, whichever is smaller); eligible models and pairs reported per k and for the floor; the headline curve uses the fixed subset eligible at k_max, the per-k eligible curve is the supplement.
